meta.title: From fund to token
meta.subtitle: How a new Australian fund becomes a token on Redbelly Network, through Tokeniser

tk-fund.title: Tokeniser knowledge hub: How to tokenise a fund in Australia

tk-works.title: Tokeniser knowledge hub: How does Tokeniser work

scenes.name: Intro
vo: Here is how a new Australian fund becomes a token on Redbelly Network, through Tokeniser, in 4 stages.
on_screen: A new Australian fund, tokenised on Redbelly Network through Tokeniser
scenes.visual: Title on a soft blue band. A thin line fund icon turns into a round token. A 4 step stage tracker draws in at the top.

claims.covers: on Redbelly Network, through Tokeniser
claims.quote: Tokeniser operates on Redbelly Network, Australia's public digital token infrastructure

claims.covers: a new Australian fund
claims.quote: New funds can be established natively on tokenised infrastructure; existing funds can be migrated.

claims.covers: in 4 stages
claims.quote: The process has four stages: legal preparation, platform onboarding, compliance configuration, and investor register establishment.

scenes.name: What tokenisation means
vo: Tokenisation records ownership as digital tokens, and lets you program the rules of the asset.
scenes.visual: A register of owners turns into a row of tokens. A small rules card clicks into each token.

claims.covers: records ownership as digital tokens, and lets you program the rules of the asset
claims.quote: Tokenisation records ownership of financial products and services as digital tokens, and lets you program the rules of the asset.

scenes.name: Stage 1, legal preparation
vo: The fund's documents must allow ownership to be recorded on a blockchain.
No separate tokenisation licence is needed in Australia.
on_screen: Fund documents allow ownership records on a blockchain
No separate tokenisation licence in Australia
scenes.visual: Stage tracker lights step 1. A trust deed page gets a tick next to the ownership clause. A licence card shows the existing licence, with no second card added.

claims.covers: Stage 1, legal preparation
claims.quote: Legal review of constitutional documents is a required first step.

claims.covers: documents must allow ownership to be recorded on a blockchain
claims.quote: Some documents need amendment to permit on-chain ownership records and electronic transfer.

claims.covers: No separate tokenisation licence is needed in Australia
claims.quote: There is no separate tokenisation licence required in Australia.

scenes.name: Stage 2, platform onboarding
vo: The manager and the fund are verified on Tokeniser, and the token is designed.
on_screen: Token designed: asset class and rules
scenes.visual: Stage tracker lights step 2. 2 cards, Manager and Fund, each get a verified tick. A token outline is drawn with labels for asset class and rules.

claims.covers: platform onboarding on Tokeniser
claims.quote: Once the legal framework is in place, the fund manager completes Tokeniser's platform onboarding process.

claims.covers: The manager and the fund are verified
claims.quote: Complete entity verification for the fund manager and the fund.

claims.covers: the token is designed: asset class and rules
claims.quote: For new funds, design the token parameters: asset class, compliance rules, and corporate action schedule.

scenes.name: Stage 3, compliance configuration
vo: Identity checks, who may invest, and transfer limits are encoded into the token and enforced automatically.
scenes.visual: Stage tracker lights step 3. 3 rule cards slide into the token. A small pill reads Enforced automatically.

claims.covers: Identity checks (KYC/AML)
claims.quote: Configure KYC/AML verification requirements for investors.

claims.covers: who may invest
claims.quote: Set investor eligibility criteria, wholesale status, accredited investor status, and foreign investor limits.

claims.covers: transfer limits
claims.quote: Set transfer restrictions, lock-up periods, permitted transferee classes, and any fund-specific restrictions.

claims.covers: encoded into the token and enforced automatically
claims.quote: Compliance rules are encoded into the token at issuance and enforced automatically at every transfer.

scenes.name: Stage 4, investor register
vo: Each investor verifies their identity and gets a digital wallet.
No tokens are issued until then.
scenes.visual: Stage tracker lights step 4. Investor cards get an identity tick, then a wallet icon. A token waits beside each card until both ticks show.

claims.covers: Each investor verifies their identity and gets a digital wallet
claims.quote: Investors complete digital onboarding, identity verification, investor classification, and wallet setup, before their tokens are issued.

claims.covers: No tokens are issued until then
claims.quote: Until onboarding is complete and the wallet is verified, tokens cannot be issued to or transferred to that investor.

scenes.name: Token issuance
vo: Tokens are then issued on Redbelly Network, into verified wallets.
From the first token, this register is the official record of ownership.
on_screen: Official ownership record from the first token
scenes.visual: Tokens move along a Redbelly Network line into the verified wallets. The register fills in row by row.

claims.covers: issued on Redbelly Network, into verified wallets
claims.quote: Tokens are minted on Redbelly Network and transferred to the verified investor wallets.

claims.covers: this register is the official record of ownership
claims.quote: The on-chain register is the register of record from day one.

claims.covers: From the first token
claims.quote: For a new fund, the investor register is established on-chain at the point of the first token issuance.

scenes.name: Transfers
vo: Every transfer is checked against the rules first, and breaches are rejected.
When investors hold their own wallet, transfer and payment complete together, in seconds.
on_screen: Own wallet: transfer and payment together, in seconds
scenes.visual: A transfer arrow reaches a checkpoint. A transfer that breaks a rule stops with a cross. A valid transfer passes, and token and payment swap at the same moment.

claims.covers: Every transfer is checked against the rules first
claims.quote: Every transfer is checked against configured compliance parameters before submission.

claims.covers: breaches are rejected
claims.quote: Transfers to unverified wallets, ineligible investors, or in breach of restrictions are rejected.

claims.covers: When investors hold their own wallet
claims.quote: the investor either holds their own private key (non-custodial wallet)

claims.covers: transfer and payment complete together, in seconds
claims.quote: For non-custodial wallets, atomic settlements, transfer and payment complete simultaneously in seconds.

scenes.name: Close
vo: Tokeniser operates on Redbelly Network, Australia's public digital token infrastructure, where transactions are confirmed once and cannot be reversed.
on_screen: Transactions confirmed once, cannot be reversed
scenes.visual: Tokeniser and Redbelly logos side by side on white, the line text below, tokeniser.com last.

claims.covers: Tokeniser operates on Redbelly Network, Australia's public digital token infrastructure
claims.quote: Tokeniser operates on Redbelly Network, Australia's public digital token infrastructure

claims.covers: transactions are confirmed once and cannot be reversed
claims.quote: Deterministic finality ensures transactions are confirmed once and cannot be reversed
